title: FakeUserService needs a per-method *Fn override for each mockable behavior
answers: How do I make FakeUserService.Delete return different results per test?
How to mock user service Delete in org_users tests?
body: usertest.FakeUserService only supports customizing behavior per test through explicit function fields (e.g. UpdateFn, DeleteFn); a new fake method must add its own <Method>Fn field and check it before falling back to ExpectedError, mirroring the existing pattern.
applies: pkg/services/user/usertest/fake.go when adding test coverage for any new FakeUserService method.
